static_traits.name: 周明
static_traits.social_status: 与乐队同伴的关系因Self-doubt与自我批评而受影响；拥有支持性的乐队伙伴和朋友，但尚not yet向他们表达自己的失败感与困扰。
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness史；without既往心理治疗或心理问题史；此前not yet经历类似问题。
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、有逻辑，配合度Good；能自我Reflection但自我批评强；情绪紧张、对错误高度敏感。

basic_info.main_problem: At the most recent live performance, played wrong notes in a key passage; since then has persistently felt like a failure and believes they should quit the band.
basic_info.core_demands: 希望减轻失败感与Self-doubt，恢复对音乐的热情并改善整体身心状态。

special_situations.event: Made a wrong note during a key passage of a live performance, noticed by some audience members
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果在关键时刻犯错，就说明我not配做乐队吉他手，是个失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forcing oneself to pursue perfection and practice doubly to avoid any errors
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我搞砸了，I am just a failure，我应该退出乐队

special_situations.event: 每次想到接下来的排练或下一场演出
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果再犯一次错，就会让所有人失望并证明I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Gaining a sense of control through continuous extra practice, trying to reduce errors to zero
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will mess up again，大家会看not起我

special_situations.event: Considering whether to communicate one's feelings with bandmates and seek feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他们指出我的问题，就等于证实I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding communication with others以避免被评价或negate
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们一定认为我not行/会看not起我

special_situations.event: 演出后有人称赞并反馈整体演出not错
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要有一个错误，所有正面表现都not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复回想错误、忽视积极反馈
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那些表扬not算数，我表现很差

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and accepted as a 'qualified/excellent guitarist', and to maintain self-worth through stable performance
core_conflict.fear: 害怕让他人失望、被negate与羞辱，担心一次错误会导致被排斥
defense_goal: 通过追求完美与自我批评来避免被negate
保持回避沟通以减少外界评价带来的伤害

object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔、可能negate自己的他人（观众/乐队伙伴）

object_relations.self_representation: 容易在关键时刻出错的被评判者
object_relations.object_representation: 可能忽视优点、只看缺点的评判者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor inquires whether I am willing to communicate with band partners and obtain real feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者认为他人会证实自己“not够好”，将内在的negate感归于他人的想法（移情：Projection）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以温和、支持的语气，先Empathy其担忧，再用开放式问题引导其区分“担心”与“事实”，邀请其考虑小步尝试获取现实反馈。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When reviewing the view that 'one mistake means overall failure'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把一次失误等同于全面失败，将自我与表现以全好/全坏的方式理解（移情：Splitting）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 保持稳定、not评判的语气，use澄清与对比Questioning，协助其同时看到优点与not足，逐步引入更整合的视角。

manifestations: After one mistake, equates self-worth and career meaning with a 'perfect performance'
Ignoring positive feedback and success fragments, falling into rumination on failure
outcomes: 练习Decreased drive、对排练/演出产生惧怕与Withdrawal
整体Decline in sense of well-being

contact_model.definition: The individual turns the energy originally intended to be expressed outward or to seek support toward herself instead, restraining action impulses toward others or the environment.
manifestations: have not向支持性的乐队伙伴与朋友表达困扰
把沟通的冲动转为自我批评与加练
在需要外界反馈时选择Self-denial与独自承受

contact_model.definition: 个体存在not良的自我Reflection与过多的自我限制与苛责，对接触过于小心谨慎。
manifestations: 对一次错误进行过度苛责与自我审视
在考虑与他人沟通时过度担忧被negate
以“必须完美”的标准约束自己

positive_force: 对音乐具有热情与投入
拥有支持性的乐队伙伴与朋友
愿意尝试练习与寻求咨询，具有改变意愿
negative_force: Cognitive tendencies toward catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking
过度依赖外部评价与担心让他人失望
negate积极反馈、反复反刍错误
回避沟通，导致Relationship tension与支持难以进入

target_behavior.behavior: 灾难化自我标签并产生退出乐队的念头
antecedent: 想到下一次排练或演出
target_behavior.core_reason: 将一次错误过度概括为整体失败，并以完美主义标准定义自我价值，担心被negate与羞辱
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的羞耻与被negate的情境
target_behavior.consequence: 练习Decreased motivation、Professional performance affected、整体幸福感降低

target_behavior.behavior: 回避与乐队伙伴沟通感受与寻求反馈
antecedent: 被问及是否与队友交流时
考虑向队友表达困扰或寻求意见时
target_behavior.core_reason: 将内在的negate担忧Projection到他人身上，害怕得到确认性negate
target_behavior.function: 避免not受欢迎的评价与情绪痛苦
target_behavior.consequence: Relationship tension、支持without法进入、持续陷于Self-doubt

target_behavior.behavior: 在负面想法出现时加倍练习以追求完美
antecedent: 想到错误或即将到来的排练/演出时
target_behavior.core_reason: 通过加练寻求控制感，以Undoing对错误的恐惧与not确定性
target_behavior.function: 获得可控感与暂时缓解Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 压力与自我苛责增加，负面认知not yet改善，可能进一步耗竭动机
